name: print-social-white-grid-card-workshops-photo-carousel-slide
title: Workshops List Slide with Photo Stack
whatItIs: A portrait carousel slide listing four workshops with date pills and small avatars, plus a diagonal stack of rounded event photos at right, on the same grid-paper card series.
whatItMeans: Date pills and avatars make a list scannable and personal, and real photos add credibility.
techniques: Outlined blue pill for each date
Avatar next to every item to show who
Bold organisation names inside light copy
Rounded photos staggered along the right edge
Consistent header and footer chrome across the series

vocabulary.definition: A rounded outlined chip containing a date.
A cascade of overlapping rounded photos.
Repeated header and footer elements that unify slides.
